vetSays.line: 🛡️ Anna, Kavya, Siyabonga and Dinara met them at the door — 4 put down. Anna, Kavya, Siyabonga, Dinara are hurt.
🛡️ Siyabonga, Dinara, Nikolai and Ruth met them at the door — 4 put down. Siyabonga, Dinara, Ruth are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder The Heckler falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder The Heckler!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Siyabonga just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruth just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Francisco, Siyabonga, Dinara, Nikolai and Ruth met them at the door — 5 put down. Francisco, Siyabonga, Dinara, Ruth are hurt.
🛡️ Siyabonga, Dinara, Nikolai, Ruth and Nathan met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Siyabonga, Dinara, Nikolai, Ruth, Nathan are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Siyabonga just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Siyabonga, Dinara, Nikolai, Ruth and Nathan met them at the door — 5 put down. Siyabonga, Nikolai, Ruth, Nathan are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chantal just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ethan and Chantal met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Ethan is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ethan just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ethan just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred The Big Beast falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred The Big Beast!
🛡️ Aroha met them at the door — 1 put down. Aroha is hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aroha just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Aroha met them at the door — 1 put down. Aroha is hurt.
